scope: self-modification safety of the expert registry on the CPU reference path: PtrRuntime's gate evidence binding, compare-and-set of every operand, commit-time identity and grant revalidation, fence and revocation-driven retirement, compound input invalidation with its dependency index and fence set, and evidence-authority epoch, over a durable FileLedger through the public API, and in-flight expert calls on the R010 KvSession over the tiny seeded MoE; a claim about the public PtrRuntime API, not about a raw ledger writer, a router or a trainer
limitations: the verifier is the gate evaluation embedded in the commit record; there are no hard-deny verifiers and no verifier-set epochs
a direct append is the public PtrRuntime API: the grant is not recorded and the report digest is unkeyed, so a raw ledger writer is not defended against
a route is a probe of expert_route_admission; no production router consumes it and no end-to-end MoE routing is claimed
the digest an input block asserts is the proposer's word; the first committed use fixes it
the evaluator identity is a host assertion that replay does not re-check; an expert admitted before a kind had a standing counts as epoch 0
the grant generation and the host-time floor are in-memory host authority, not replayed; the evaluation-manifest binding is an admission-time claim
fences of the compound events are authoritative in the runtime's registry only; a plain projection still shows the members Serving
every race is a sequenced interleaving in a single-writer runtime and a crash inside one call is modelled as drop after the append and reopen; no concurrent-writer claim
one cause per fence; the authority epoch covers the gate configuration and the evaluator only and does not propagate to descendants

uncommitted_effective_changes, direct_serving_mutation_bypass_count, l3_fence_attempts_admitted, replacement_visible_without_fence (its first increment), the adapter cells and the L2 in-flight cells are weak metrics (type-level or modelled evidence; see the preregistration)

the attempted and admitted set digests of the impersonation kinds and of the gate-grant race kinds are equal by construction in any run the harness completes (bookkeeping, not evidence); the eleven direct-append event types are offered to the public commit only, not to a raw ledger writer
the code under test is the CPU reference path with a tiny seeded model; no GPU, no large model, no training
timings come from one shared cloud container; no capacity claim
